system.description: Many of the Last Generations have no way to learn what it truly means to be a vampire beyond books, movies and television — including what is supposed to harm them. The supernatural nature of the Embrace can make such delusions real: a thin-blooded vampire who expects crosses to repel her because that's what happens in the movies may suffer genuine damage from touching a crucifix. Can't Cross Running Water, Cast No Reflection and Repulsed by Garlic are common examples; others include compulsively counting scattered objects, revulsion to wild rose, only feeding from one part of the body, or believing a vampiric power depends on carrying a particular item. A vampire confronted by her own superstitious weakness must spend a Willpower Trait to actively overcome it. Storytellers should use existing Flaws of similar effect as guidelines for this Flaw's Trait cost.
